description: Covered call (long the coin + short a call against it, for yield) or protective put (long the coin + long a put, for downside insurance) on a Deribit BTC/ETH position. Returns the standard annualized-yield metric (premium ÷ 1 coin, annualized by 365/daysToExpiry) up front: that number doesn't depend on any price scenario. Also returns the USD value of the combined position at a given scenario price: covered call caps upside at strike + premium×scenarioPrice (the premium's own coin-denominated value still scales with price, unlike a textbook USD-settled cap); protective put floors value at strike×(1−premium), which is the true minimum across every possible settlement price, not just an approximation. Use when user asks "what annualized yield do I get selling covered calls on my BTC?" or "how much does insuring my BTC with a put cost me?". Returns: staticYieldPct, annualizedYieldPct, valueAtScenarioUsd, breakevenPrice (covered_call only), floorValueUsd (protective_put only), vsHoldingUsd (vs. just holding the coin). With exchange "binance" (USDT-settled, premiumUsdt) the yield is premium divided by spotEntry (one unit is not a fraction of a coin), annualized by 365/daysToExpiry, and it returns: staticYieldPct, annualizedYieldPct, valueAtScenarioUsdt (covered call = min(S, K) + premium per unit), breakevenPrice (covered_call: spotEntry - premium, null when the cap sits below the cost), capValuePerUnitUsdt (covered_call: strike + premium), floorValuePerUnitUsdt (protective_put: strike - premium), vsHoldingUsdt; USDT is not converted to USD.

currency.description: Underlying. Default BTC. XAU and XAG (gold, silver) only with exchange binance.

daysToExpiry.description: Calendar days until expiry; used to annualize the yield/cost

exchange.description: Venue whose settlement rules apply. "deribit" (default): BTC/ETH, coin-settled, premium in the base coin. "binance": BTC/ETH/XAU/XAG, USDT-settled, flat payoff max(0, S-K) per unit, premium in USDT (use the *Usdt premium fields); the result carries exchange and settlement fields.

premiumCoin.description: Deribit only. Premium received (covered_call) or paid (protective_put) per contract, in the base coin

premiumUsdt.description: Binance only. Premium received (covered_call) or paid (protective_put) per unit, in USDT; must be < spotEntry for a covered call and < strike for a protective put

scenarioPrice.description: Underlying price in USD to evaluate the combined position's value at

spotEntry.description: Price you acquired/value the underlying coin at, USD; used for the covered-call breakeven vs. cost basis

strategy.description: "covered_call" (hold the coin, sell a call against it) or "protective_put" (hold the coin, buy a put as insurance)
